description:
Self-serve free tier — the rung between anonymous access and paid
blocks. One email in, one API key out, shown exactly once.

Use this tool when:
- You are calling anonymously and hitting the anonymous rate limit.
- You want your calls identified so usage survives IP changes.

Limits:
- 50 requests/day (same endpoints as anonymous, higher ceiling).
- One active free key per email; 3 signups per IP per day.
- The raw key is returned once and stored only as a SHA-256 hash —
  it cannot be recovered, only revoked and reissued.

Cost: free. No card, no account — the email is the revocation
handle, nothing more.
name: create_free_key
